entries.wording: 货品已送达义乌深国际仓，仓库已收货
entries.english: The goods reached the Yiwu warehouse, which received them
entries.note: The shipper's goods are received at one of HUBO's warehouses in China, the first scan after the order.

entries.wording: 货品已送达广州江高仓，仓库已收货
entries.english: The goods reached the Guangzhou Jianggao warehouse, which received them
entries.note: The warehouse receipt under the newer codes, written by HUBO's system.
The goods are loaded into the sea container in China.

entries.wording: 国内报关已放行，ETD: 11.17，ETA: 12.04，船名船次：CSCL AUTUMN 076E
entries.english: Export customs released; departure, arrival and vessel
entries.note: China's customs released the export declaration; the text names the planned departure and arrival and the vessel.
The vessel left China; the text gives the expected arrival.
The destination warehouse signed for the goods. The reply links pictures of the receipt, which the adapter leaves out.

entries.wording: 此柜更新ETA：12.05，实际到港以船司官网显示为准
entries.english: The container's arrival is now expected on another day
entries.note: A notice of a new departure or arrival date, such as a delay before sailing; it keeps the stage of the scan before it.
Rows without a code are free text by HUBO's staff, often with dates, so the map reads the first of these phrases a text contains, in this order. A planned signature (预约…签收) does not contain it.
The container is unpacked at the destination, before delivery to the warehouse: "已提柜，已拆柜完成，预约当地4.24号签收".
The container is collected from the port of arrival.
The container is unloaded at the port of arrival: "货物已卸船，待确认提柜时间".
The vessel reached the port of arrival and customs released the goods: "货物已到港，清关已放行，还未卸船".
The vessel left China: "已开船；ETA：4.19。".
China's customs released the export declaration: "国内报关已放行，ETD：4.04  ETA：4.19。", with the vessel.
The goods are loaded into the sea container in China.
One of HUBO's warehouses in China received the goods: "货品已送达义乌深国际仓，仓库已收货".
HUBO's order is created, with its number, before the goods reach a warehouse.
A delay before sailing, with a new departure date: "因船晚靠，开船时间有延误，预计ETD：4.06，待确认开船后更新". It moves nothing.
A booked collection of the container or delivery to the warehouse, still to come: "预约当地4.23号提柜".

A row copied from the delivery partner abroad, in English: "United States,Label Created, Order Processed: In Transit to UPS". The label for the last leg is made while the goods are at sea, so it moves nothing.
